params.1274: Acquire a bronze bar (you can smelt one from tin and copper ore).
params.1275: Get a hammer. Smithing master Martin Steelweaver can sell you one.
params.1276: Find an anvil. There is one near Martin.
params.1277: Open your inventory and click on your bronze bar to select it.
params.1278: Click on the anvil and choose to make a bronze dagger.
params.2225: A higher Smithing level will allow you to make more weapons and armour out of stronger metals.
